The '''Koorivar''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] distinguished by their banded noses and a slender cranial horn that spiraled upwards from the center of their skull. A shrewd people, the Koorivar strove to make their society one where corporate-mindedness was essential to each citizen. Through the combined efforts of the Koorivar people, these sentients were able to purchase a new [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] called [[Kooriva/Legends|Kooriva]] from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], following the loss of their [[Koorivar homeworld/Legends|native planet]].

==Biology and appearance==
A tall [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] species, the Koorivar craniums were studded with several small twisting horns, all of which surrounded a central spiraling one. Consisting of many shades of color, the spiraling horn was a mark of status in Koorivarn culture; those Koorivar with a genetic disposition to growing larger horns dominated the upper class of society. The horn itself developed in adolescence during puberty, and would continue to grow taller and thicker until reaching adulthood. In addition to their cranial horn, the Koorivar were marked by banded ridges that studded their brows and nose. Appearing in a riot of colors, Koorivar spoke in a soft whispering [[Koorivar (language)|language]] which focused on body language. This aided them in the business world when communicating in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], as they could pick up on others gestures more acutely.<ref name="NEGAS" />

==History==
[[File:Koorivar_Fusilier.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A member of the [[Koorivar Fusiliers/Legends|Koorivar Fusiliers]] adorned in red armor.]]
Native to a [[Koorivar homeworld/Legends|lost world]], the Koorivar were forced to abandon their home when its life-giving [[Star/Legends|star]] became unstable. Traveling [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the Koorivar settled on the tropical [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] planet [[Kooriva/Legends|Kooriva]], formally leasing it from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. After centuries of living on the world, they adopted the name Koorivar and petitioned the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] to allow them to purchase the world. Upon being turned down, the Koorviar were ousted by Kooriva's indigenous people and were forced to wander the galaxy. Instead of being defeated, the Koorivar strove to gain sway over members of the Senate through bargaining and corporate trickery.<ref name="NEGAS" />

For over half a millennium the Kooriva traveled from planet to planet scheming and working to gain enough votes to overturn the decision that lost them their home. The Koorivar were ultimately successful in their endeavors and were able to return to Koorivar, gaining membership in the Galactic Senate and becoming closely tied with the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]]. To keep Kooriva's market high, the species seeded the galaxy with agents, trading stocks and selling shares to increase their profit. Despite such successful strides, when the Koorivar attempted to sell war machines to battling peoples on both sides of planetary conflicts, their reputation was ruined and their market crashed following a Republic investigation, [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] and sanctions. To get the Republic to back off, the Koorivar took great strides to comply with all of the Republic's demands and hide any illegal deals more thoroughly. As the Republic began to decline, the Koorivar elected Corporate Alliance [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]] [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]] as their planet's representative in the Galactic Senate. During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], Argente withdrew Kooriva from the Republic and took up a seat on the [[Separatist Council/Legends|ruling council]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. To protect their interests on foreign worlds during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Argente raised an army of his own people known as the [[Koorivar Fusiliers/Legends|Koorivar Fusiliers]], a pivotal fighting force during the war.<ref name="NEGAS" />

[[File:Koorivar.jpg|thumb|right|220px|A lone Koorivar wanders the streets of Coruscant during the Clone Wars.]]

During the war, Koorivar were deported in droves from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] because of the species' affiliation with the Confederacy. Despite the illegality of their presence, many Koorivar refused to leave the planet and were forced to stroll the streets with caution and fear.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Covetous">''[[The Clone Wars: Covetous]]''</ref> At the war's height, the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] was [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|slaughtered]] by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], killing Passel Argente and spelling the demise of the Confederacy and the Corporate Alliance. With Argente dead, the Alliance fled to the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] and quickly faded away.<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> On Koorivar Republic soldiers, now under the banner of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], persecuted the Koorivar for their involvement in the war and sent their economy into a downwards spiral. Despite the biases towards non-Humans prevalent during the reign of the Empire, the Koorivar were swift in taking up leading roles in the corporate world of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and despite the setbacks of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the species continued to thrive under the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]; not withstanding the added scrutiny of the [[Galactic Alliance Committee on Corporate Oversight]].<ref name="NEGAS" />

==Society and culture==
As a society, the Koorivar prized financial prowess so much that all schools and academies on their home planet focused on the business arts. It was not uncommon for children as young as ten standard years old to have begun working or to have started their own business. Marriages on the planet were handled in the same fashion, with love considered to be unprofitable. Most Koorivar found jobs as merchants or nobles, ascending to the top of corporations across the galaxy and locking in a controlling interest in many different enterprises.<ref name="NEGAS" />

In regards to physical features, the Koorivar prized their central cranial horn as a symbol of dominance and social class. An unofficial class of superior Koorivar evolved to be made up of members of the species with thick, long horns which they decorated and adorned to emphasize their beauty. Females who had given birth to a child and raised a family draped a matron's hood over their head to note their importance in society. Loss of a horn was a damning thing, resulting in the loss of an individual's position in society, and on some occasions ended in banishment.<ref name="NEGAS" />

==Koorivar in the galaxy==
[[File:Passelrots.jpg|thumb|left|140px|Corporate Alliance Magistrate Passel Argente.]]
While the bulk of the species maintained residence on the planet [[Kooriva/Legends|Kooriva]], the species roams the galaxy as merchants and nobles striking up new deals where deals are to be had and increasing their commercial ties. Establishing colonies on planets such as [[Murkhana/Legends|Murkhana]] and [[Bomis Koori IV]], the Koorivar could be spotted on Coruscant even after the species suffered mass-deportation during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Common Koorivar names included Shand Essil, Terrem Jesond, Menas Neyrr, and Leosa Vantare.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> While at least one Koorivar entered into the ranks of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], wielding a [[blue]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] during [[Operation Influx]] during the [[New Sith Wars]],<ref name="Knight Errant: Aflame 1">[[Knight Errant 1|''Knight Errant'' 1]]</ref> a [[Unidentified Koorivar Sith acolyte|Koorivar male]] was actively undergoing training as an [[Sith acolyte/Legends|acolyte]] in the [[One Sith|Order of the Sith]] under the leadership of [[Darth Krayt]] circa [[137 ABY]].<ref name="Legacy 2006 34">[[Legacy (2006) 34|''Legacy'' (2006) 34]]</ref>

One of the most famed Koorivar was Magistrate [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]] of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]]. A member of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Council]] which led the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Argente and his aide [[Denaria Kee/Legends|Denaria Kee]] were [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|assassinated]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] at the end of the conflict.<ref name="ROTS" /> Among the ranks of the [[Koorivar Fusiliers/Legends|Koorivar Fusiliers]] was [[General/Legends|General]] [[Oro Dassyne/Legends|Oro Dassyne]], a hornless male who perished during the war,<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 22">{{CW|22}}</ref> and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Terrus]] of the [[313th Legion]].<ref name="The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: The Lost Legion">''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: The Lost Legion]]''</ref>
